description: Source code for testing and reading multi-pack index (midx) files in a Git-related project, including functions to load, display, and process midx files and their components.

methods.name: setup_midx
methods.description: Initializes and loads a multi-pack index from a given object directory.

methods.name: read_midx_file
methods.description: Reads and displays information about a midx file, optionally showing objects.

methods.name: read_midx_checksum
methods.description: Outputs the checksum of a midx file.

methods.name: read_midx_preferred_pack
methods.description: Displays the preferred pack in a midx file.

methods.name: read_midx_bitmapped_packs
methods.description: Displays bitmapped pack information within a midx file.

methods.name: cmd__read_midx
methods.description: Command-line interface function to process arguments and invoke appropriate midx reading functions.
